facts.material: printed circuit board assembly (electronic control assembly) populated with push-button momentary contact switches, LEDs, resistors, photodiodes, 40-pin connector, mounted on a backplate and front bezel

Section XVII note 2(f): electrical machinery and equipment of chapter 85 is not a 'part' of aircraft of chapter 88, so heading 8803 is excluded

Section XVI note 2(a): a part that is itself a good of a chapter 85 heading is classified in that heading; the panel with two or more switches of heading 8536 mounted on a backplate and bezel is a panel equipped with apparatus of 8536 for electric control of heading 8537 (chapter 85 note 4 excludes populated boards from 8534)
GRI 6: 8537.10 for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V; 8537.10.91 other; suffix .70 other (not switchgear, numerical control, panel/distribution boards or programmable controllers)

parts of 8537 apparatus; the subassembly is itself a panel equipped with two or more 8536 switches, a good of 8537 (section XVI note 2(a))
parts of navigational instruments; chapter 90 note 2(a) keeps goods of a chapter 85 heading in that heading
chapter 85 note on printed circuits excludes boards populated with other components

classification.rationale: The control panel subassembly lacks the LCD display and calibration, so it does not have the essential character of a complete MCDU under GRI 2(a). Section XVII note 2(f) prevents it from being an aircraft part of 8803, and Section XVI note 2(a) classifies a part in its own heading when it is a named good. As a board and bezel equipped with multiple push-button switches of heading 8536 for electric control, it fits heading 8537, as CBP held for a switch-populated control PCB in NY N004021 (8537.10.9070), giving 8537.10.91.70. Classification as a part of the MCDU's own heading is a real alternative.

classification.rationale: The PA6-imide product is an extruded polyamide monofilament 1.75 mm in diameter, which exceeds 1 mm, so heading 3916 covers it rather than the textile monofilament provisions of chapter 54. The spools are ordinary holding devices. CBP classified 3D-printing filament of another plastic (PEEK) as monofilament in 3916.90.3000 (N356246, in force). The polyamide filament falls in 3916.90.30.00.
